effects.printed_clause: If you Special Summon an "Altergeist": Special Summon this card from hand or GY; if from GY, banish it when it leaves; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Field trigger from hand/GY detects an Altergeist Summoned by you, Special Summons this card, and if its previous location was GY registers an unresettable leave-field redirect; id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: GY-origin Special Summon with leave-field banish redirect.

effects.printed_clause: If Normal or Special Summoned: add a Trap from Deck that lists "Altergeist"; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Cloned Normal/Special Summon triggers search Traps that are Altergeist, Personal Spoofing, or metadata-list an Altergeist name; separate HOPT key.

official_references.matched_structure: Printed-name/list metadata filtering through aux.IsCodeListed-style support.

coverage_override.reason: The self-Summon trigger includes both source locations, the GY leave-field redirect, and its HOPT. The Normal/Special Summon search and its separate HOPT are the second effect.
